slides.headline: 6 CLAUDE SKILLS PEOPLE ARE QUIETLY USING TO REPLACE STAFF
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei, waist-up, triumphant grin, holds phone with Claude logo in both hands toward camera. Office chairs, glowing Claude symbol screens. Terracotta neon sign on bright cobalt wall. Bright documentary photo, 35mm film grain.

slides.headline: 1) BUILD A CLAUDE THAT ANSWERS CLIENTS WITHOUT YOU
slides.body:
She pasted her FAQ. Clients get answered in 30 seconds.

"You know my business inside out. Everything is here: [paste]. Answer any question a client could ask"

slides.headline: 2) TURN A VOICE NOTE INTO A STAFF CHECKLIST
slides.body:
A bakery owner talked for 90 seconds. He got a 12-step checklist his new hires follow daily.

"[Transcript]. Write a step-by-step checklist a new hire can follow without asking me anything"
slides.image_prompt: Close on two hands: left holding a phone displaying a waveform arc symbol, right resting beside a printed sheet covered in checkbox rows and tick marks — no readable text. Warm golden morning light on a wooden counter, vivid cream-yellow wall behind. Documentary news photo, 35mm, slight film grain. Accent: golden amber against warm cream.

slides.headline: 3) TURN SALES CALL NOTES INTO AN EMAIL THAT CLOSES
slides.body:
She pasted call notes. Her follow-up closed 3 of the next 4 prospects.

"[Call notes]. Write a follow-up email that names their pain, restates my offer, and ends with one clear ask"

slides.headline: 4) CLONE YOUR WRITING VOICE SO AI SOUNDS EXACTLY LIKE YOU
slides.body:
A coach pasted 10 emails. Claude now writes in her exact voice, no editing needed.

"[My emails]. Study my tone. Write everything I ask in this exact voice from now on"

slides.headline: 5) FILTER OUT TIME-WASTERS BEFORE THE FIRST CALL
slides.body:
A realtor shared his buyer criteria. Zero wasted calls in 30 days.

"My ideal client: [describe]. Write 5 questions to filter out anyone who is not serious before our first call"

slides.headline: 6) TURN ONE PROJECT INTO A CASE STUDY THAT SELLS
slides.body:
A designer described one project. The case study Claude wrote landed 2 new clients.

"[Project result]. Write a 150-word case study that makes the reader say I need to hire this person"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 6 CLAUDE SKILLS WORTH STARTING TODAY
slides.body:

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 6. 🔖 Ten years ago Bitcoin was $586 and most people missed it. These are the AI skills people will wish they started in 2026.

Build a Claude that knows your entire business and answers clients without you, turn a voice note into a step-by-step staff checklist your new hires follow from day one, convert any sales call notes into a follow-up email that closes, clone your exact writing voice so every AI reply sounds like you wrote it, send 5 questions before any call to filter out time-wasters, and turn one real project result into a 150-word case study that lands new clients.

Every skill here compounds the longer you use it. The business owners setting these up now will be six months ahead of everyone who waits until it is obvious. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
